/*selectMasterMdCmCatalogByitPopList*/ SELECT /*+LEADING(D)*/ A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = C.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, C.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME, C.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, C.LIST_PRICE AS LIST_PRICE, C.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = C.BELOW_COMORG_CODE) AS BELOW_TEXT, DECODE(NVL(DECODE(SUBSTR(A.STDCATLG_ID,0,1),'M',A.STDCATLG_ID,''),'00'),'00','NO','YES') AS MAPP_TEXT, A.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, A.BUYER AS BUYER, A.STATUS AS BYIT_STATUS, A.CMS_CATLG_ID AS STDCATLG_ID, A.CMS_CATEG_ID AS STDCATEG_ID, A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG AS PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, C.BELOW_COMORG_CODE AS BELOW_COMORG_CODE, C.STATUS AS CQDT_STATUS, C.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, C.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, C.AGENT AS AGENT, (SELECT /*+USE_NL(C P)*/ COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCQEP P WHERE P.BUYER = C.BUYER AND P.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND P.CONTRACT_NO = C.CONTRACT_NO AND P.CONTRACT_SEQ = C.CONTRACT_SEQ) AS CQEP_CNT, C.CHANGE_DATE AS CHANGE_DATE, C.ADD_DATE AS ADD_DATE, C.ITEM_MAKE_TYPE, C.DELIVERY_LT, A.MSDS_NO, 1 AS PRINT, A.REFINE_NOTE, C.TO_DATE, A.MAKER_PART_NO, A.KEP_MAKER_PART_NO, (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = A.REFINE_USER_ID) AS REFINE_USER_NM, (SELECT COUNT(MNG.BUYER_ITEM_NO) FROM KEPBTOA_MNG MNG WHERE MNG.BUYER = C.BUYER AND MNG.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = C.BELOW_COMORG_CODE AND MNG.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO ) BTOA_MNG_CNT, F_GET_RE_SGMNG(C.BELOW_COMORG_CODE, A.CMS_CATEG_ID, '',3) AS SOUR_MNG FROM ICOMBYIT A, ICOMBYCA B, ICOMCQDT C WHERE A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND C.ADD_DATE BETWEEN '20010416' AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.BUYER = B.COM_CODE AND A.CATEGORY_NO = B.STD_CATEG_ID AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND C.STATUS != 'D' AND A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' AND C.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND C.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = (SELECT CMPY.BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE= #{st_buyer_code})
AND (C.AGENT = #{st_agent_code} OR C.ORIGIN_AGENT = #{st_agent_code})
AND C.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE #{st_buyer_item_no}||'%'
AND UPPER(A.DESCRIPTION_LOC) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{st_description}||'%')
AND UPPER(A.SPECIFICATION) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{st_specification}||'%')
AND UPPER(C.MAKER_NAME) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{st_maker_name}||'%')
AND A.CMS_CATEG_ID IN ( SELECT COD.CODE2 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD WHERE COD.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD.TYPE = 'SG' AND CODE1 = #{st_kep_user_id} AND FLAG = 'Y' )
AND C.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE 'M'||'%'
AND A.CMS_CATEG_ID IN (SELECT COD.CODE2 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD WHERE COD.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD.TYPE = 'SSG' AND CODE1 = #{st_sg_user_id} AND FLAG = 'Y' MINUS SELECT COD.CODE2 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD WHERE COD.BUYER = C.BELOW_COMORG_CODE AND COD.TYPE = 'ESG' AND CODE1 != #{st_sg_user_id} AND FLAG = 'Y' )
ORDER BY A.BUYER_ITEM_NO
